entity_types.name: Accident
entity_types.description: An aviation accident or incident event investigated by the NTSB.

entity_types.name: Aircraft
entity_types.description: A specific physical aircraft involved in an accident investigation.

entity_types.name: AircraftModel
entity_types.description: A standardized aircraft make and model specification, but not an individual physical airframe.

entity_types.name: CrewMember
entity_types.description: A pilot, flight instructor, student pilot, or occupant on board an aircraft during an accident.

entity_types.name: Occurrence
entity_types.description: A sequential operational event, mechanical failure, or collision that took place during the accident sequence.

entity_types.name: Finding
entity_types.description: An investigative causal factor, finding, or probable cause officially determined by the NTSB.

entity_types.name: AircraftComponent
entity_types.description: A physical system, structural assembly, or mechanical part of an aircraft, but not the entire aircraft itself.

entity_types.name: Location
entity_types.description: A named geographic town, city, or state where an accident occurred.

entity_types.name: EnvironmentalCondition
entity_types.description: A weather phenomenon, terrain feature, or surface condition encountered during the accident sequence.

fact_types.description: The aircraft was involved in the accident event.
The aircraft is of the specified standardized aircraft model.
The crew member or occupant was involved in the accident.
The crew member or occupant was on board the aircraft during the flight.
The component is a physical part or subsystem of the aircraft.
The accident took place at the specified geographic location.
The sequence event or occurrence took place during the accident.
The operational event or mechanical failure affected, damaged, or involved the aircraft component.
The operational maneuver or event was conducted by or involved the crew member.
The event or maneuver encountered the environmental or terrain condition.
The investigative finding or probable cause was determined for the accident.
The finding cited the actions, decisions, or performance of the crew member.
The finding cited the failure, damage, or condition of the aircraft component.
The finding cited the environmental, weather, or terrain condition as a causal or contributing factor.
The accident flight sequence occurred under or encountered the environmental condition.
The aircraft operated with or recorded a quantitative metric, such as weight or fuel quantity.
The aircraft component had accumulated an operating or inspection time value.
